hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Compute the total bitwise xor sum of all elements in nums.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: We want this cumulative bitwise xor sum to equal k.

hints.title: Algorithmic Steps
hints.text: Each bit flip in any element flips the corresponding bit in the cumulative bitwise xor sum. The minimum operations is simply the number of set bits in (xor_sum ^ k).

hints.title: Implementation

variables: n: length of input array nums
complexity.notes: Single pass cumulative bitwise xor sum and popcount.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Trying to modify specific individual numbers is unnecessary when operations commute globally.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize that bit flips commute across array elements in bitwise xor.
